name: Vitrifila resonans
story: Long, straight, almost unbranched hyphae as clear as glass, drawn taut across open ground. It wastes nothing on side branches and almost never fuses. Invented by Claude on 2026-11-10 for the plugins: not a real species, and any likeness of the name to a real one is accidental. It takes every value it does not set from the CORD-L family.
